span.p:
seal_for_operations()
TWO-KEY auth
cooldown enforced
powers down GPU Platform

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
open_bootstrap_window()
TWO-KEY auth
cooldown enforced
powers up GPU Platform

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
request_sme_handshake()
single-key auth
NO cooldown — armed immediately
powers GPU Platform to L1.2 (pre-warm)
handshake timer resets

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
sme_accepts_handshake()
single-key auth, no cooldown
GPU Platform L1.2 → full inference
extra relay protection ON
starts 15-min session timer

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
cancel_handshake() or
handshake_timed_out()
no cooldown
powers down GPU Platform (L1.2 → off)
(SME declined or did not answer)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
sme_hangs_up() (manual) or
investigation_timer_expires() (timeout)
no cooldown
microVMs powered off
RAM cryptographically erased
audit hash sealed in permanent memory
powers down GPU Platform

Handshake gate (~60-s default)
System has called the SME and
is waiting for them to accept
GPU Platform PRE-WARMED (L1.2 ready, no inference)
No orchestration writes
Auto-returns to SEALED on timeout

div.style: display: inline-block; padding-right: 1px; white-space: nowrap;
display: inline-block; padding-right: 1px; white-space: nowrap;
div.span:
Live SME troubleshooting (15-min session)
GPU Platform POWERED (inference only)
NO orchestration writes
Read station + process bus
Read settings + COMTRADE
Extra relay protection ENABLED

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bootstrap window typical durations:
• Initial commission: 30 days
• Quarterly recal: 1-2 days
• Post-incident: hours to days

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Default production state.
Voice tags queue for next BOOTSTRAP.
Novel events flagged for review.
Catch-up batch on next open.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One-way: cannot return to FACTORY.
Commissioning is irreversible.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Short-lived diagnostic mode.
On exit (SME hangs up OR timer):
• microVMs powered off
• RAM crypto-erased
• erase-hash committed to
permanent audit memory
Auto-returns to SEALED.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Handshake gate.
INVESTIGATION cannot be entered
without the SME explicitly
accepting the call here.
GPU Platform is pre-warmed to L1.2
during the wait so accept→
inference is sub-second.
If they don't answer, the
handshake_timed_out event
returns the system to SEALED
and powers the GPU Platform back down.
